huggingface.api: huggingface_hub.InferenceClient.chat_completion, auto-routed Hugging Face Inference Providers, free tier
huggingface.cost_note: Free tier under the account's own Hugging Face token; no billing configured.
huggingface.determinism_note: Temperature/seed are accepted by the client but the serving backend is auto-routed and not exposed by the API; determinism is not guaranteed across requests or over time.

openai.determinism_note: No determinism guarantee. Omit unsupported temperature/seed rather than silently retry with changed settings.
